patthana8.27:1.1: na ganthaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ganthaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na ganthaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na aganthaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na ganthaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ganthaniyo ca na aganthaniyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.27:2.1: na aganthaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na aganthaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.27:3.1: na ganthaniyañca na aganthaniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na ganthaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana8.27:4.1: hetuyā pañca avigate pañca sabbattha pañca. na ganthasampayuttadukaṃ
